description: Lists the authors of mentions of your keywords. Each has name, profile, platform, how many posts matched and how many scored relevant, sentiment split, first and last seen, and outreach status (owner, stage, last contacted). You can filter by platform or name, find one person by handle or profile link (handle), and filter by outreach stage (stages), owner (ownerIds, or "none" for no owner) or automated (bots whose posts are mostly machine-made). Sort by mentions or by recency. To read what one person said, use search_mentions with personId.

automated.description: true keeps people whose matched posts are mostly machine-made, such as bots. false keeps the others

handle.description: Looks up one person by an account, given as a handle (@sam, u/sam) or a profile or post link (https://x.com/sam). The match is exact but ignores case. Add platform to pick one platform

intents.description: Has a mention tagged with one of these intents

keywordKinds.description: Keeps people who mentioned a keyword of one of these kinds (brand, competitor, topic)

linkHosts.description: Keeps people with a mention that links to one of these hosts or its subdomains, so slack.com also matches api.slack.com

minFollowers.description: Keeps people with this many followers or more. Unknown counts are left out

muted.description: true keeps muted people and false people who are not muted. Leave it out for everyone

neverKeywordKinds.description: Excludes people who mentioned these keyword kinds

newSinceDays.description: Keeps people first seen in the past this many days

offset.description: How many people to skip, for paging

ownerIds.description: Keeps people owned by one of these members, by user id. Use "none" for people without an owner

platform.description: Only people with a profile on this platform

platforms.description: Keeps people with an account on one of these platforms

q.description: Searches the display name, handle and profile link

segmentId.description: Adds a saved segment's filter (from list_segments) to the other filters

since.description: Keeps people whose first matched mention is at this time or later, as ISO 8601 or epoch ms. Use it to find new voices

sort.description: "mentions" puts the most matches first, "recent" the most recently seen, "reach" the most followers, and "new" people seen for the first time most recently

stages.description: Only people in one of these outreach stages

items.description: The outreach stage your team has reached with this person.

tags.description: Keeps people with one of these tags

name: list_people
title: List people
